purpose: Owner-authorized collection of the exact registered query string HHCPO for 5y standalone Google Trends. Taxonomy registration state is identity-unverified; this run measures the string as submitted and does not resolve chemical identity or aliases. Window is a weekly-grid declared approximation of the relative timeframe.

temporal_provenance.boundary_semantics: relative timeframe resolved by the collector at request time; weekly buckets (Sunday start) label the series; observed range 2021-11-07..2026-11-08
limitations: collector window type is relative_duration; the absolute requested window cannot be expressed exactly (boundary semantics unverified, c.md §6.2)
'today 5-y' is resolved nominally at the recorded reference time; Google Trends resolves it at request time and the actual boundaries are unverified (c.md §6.3)
coverage is recorded as partial/unknown until boundary verification (c.md §9)
